description: This file contains C# source code defining data structures, configuration settings, and environment invariants for testing relational storage in the Orleans framework. It includes classes for storage connection details, test environment settings, and a class to enforce environment invariants before running tests, such as ensuring storage connectivity and emulator status.

classes.name: StorageConnection
classes.description: A serializable struct representing a storage connection with invariant name and connection string.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentSettings
classes.description: A serializable class holding a collection of storage connections and an environment identifier for test configuration.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentInvariant
classes.description: A class that enforces environment invariants for testing, including storage connectivity and emulator status, with methods to load settings and verify storage reachability.

methods.name: TestEnvironmentInvariant
methods.description: Constructor that initializes active settings by merging default settings with custom configurations.

methods.name: EnsureStorageForTesting
methods.description: Ensures the specified storage connection is functional, attempting setup if necessary.

methods.name: EnsureEmulatorStorageForTesting
methods.description: Attempts to start the storage emulator if it is not already running.

methods.name: TryLoadAndMergeWithCustomSettings
methods.description: Loads custom settings from a file if available and merges them with default settings.

methods.name: CanConnectToStorage
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a storage connection is reachable.
